summary: Gmail OAuth Client-ID fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed against public preview URL. /api/gmail/start now returns a 307 redirect to accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth carrying the FULL client_id '501695473048-usisj9i3b5o4b35kr3fslavust3olomd.apps.googleusercontent.com' (with leading numeric prefix), redirect_uri=https://order-central-88.preview.emergentagent.com/api/gmail/callback, all 4 scopes (openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile, gmail.readonly), access_type=offline, prompt=consent. Following that URL with a browser UA lands on Google's real sign-in page (accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier, title 'Sign in - Google Accounts') — NOT on /signin/oauth/error and NOT with 'invalid_client'. Error-handling endpoints behave correctly: /api/gmail/session/consume w/ garbage id -> 404 'Session expired or invalid', /api/gmail/refresh w/ fake token -> 401, /api/gmail/sync w/ fake access token -> 401, /api/gmail/revoke -> {revoked: true}. Regression: /api/health OK, /api/parse/text still extracts product_name/price/platform. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Settings screen shows Connect Gmail card while ordervault.gmail.v1 is absent from localStorage. Card renders header 'Connect Gmail', 4 green ✓ perks (Read-only access, Only order-confirmation senders, Nothing stored on our servers, You can disconnect anytime), 'not verified' warning helper text, and 'Continue with Google' button with testID 'gmail-connect-btn'. Tapping the button opened a popup (WebBrowser.openAuthSessionAsync on web) whose URL is accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier with the correct client_id, all 4 scopes, redirect_uri, access_type=offline, prompt=consent — the exact same params generated by /api/gmail/start. Button also flipped label to 'Opening Google…' during connect(). OAuth entry flow is working; the reported 'invalid_client' / 'OAuth client not found' bug is FIXED.

issues: Persistent console warnings from iteration_1 remain: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py Gmail OAuth flow is clean: state stored in-memory with 600s TTL, sessions with 300s TTL, cleanup runs on each request. Acceptable for single-user preview.
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET is correctly loaded from env and only used server-side in the token exchange (never exposed to client).

gmail_refresh raises HTTPException 401 on HTTPStatusError but wraps generic Exception -> would bubble as 500. Minor: consider catching Exception -> 502 for network errors (currently untested edge case).
gmail_sync correctly surfaces Gmail's 401 as 401 and other failures as 502. Good.
No MongoDB _id leakage — endpoints return only whitelisted keys.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use only bogus/fake tokens against public endpoints; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify the Gmail OAuth Client-ID fix: run `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://order-central-88.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_gmail_oauth.py -v` (8 tests, ~5s). The full-flow-following test (test_start_google_accepts_the_url) requires outbound https to accounts.google.com and a realistic browser User-Agent; if Google returns a bot-check HTML instead of the sign-in page the assertions on final URL path (/v3/signin/identifier or /signin/*) still pass. On the frontend, to reproduce the connect flow: run localStorage.removeItem('ordervault.gmail.v1'), reload, go to Settings, and click [data-testid=gmail-connect-btn] — a popup should open to accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier with client_id starting '501695473048-'. Full human consent cannot be automated (needs real Google account).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original 'OAuth client not found / invalid_client' bug: /app/backend/.env's GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID was previously missing the leading numeric project-number prefix ('501695473048-'). Google's OAuth server rejects a client_id that isn't the full '{project_number}-{hash}.apps.googleusercontent.com' shape with 'OAuth client was not found'. Fix already applied in .env (line 4: GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID=501695473048-usisj9i3b5o4b35kr3fslavust3olomd.apps.googleusercontent.com). Verified server picks it up (test_start_returns_redirect_to_google_with_correct_params) and Google accepts it (test_start_google_accepts_the_url landed on /v3/signin/identifier). Frontend popup URL confirmed the same full client_id is propagated. No further action needed.
